messages:
alex: Giving away a Technics-style belt-drive turntable (works, spins, needs a little alignment) + a potted Monstera deliciosa. Moving out Friday from SoMa — curbside pickup only. Photos: https://imgur.com/abc123. DM to claim, drop by 2-3pm ideally. Help lifting would be appreciated :)

jamal: dm'd — can pick up Fri afternoon. Does the turntable include a preamp or cables?

alex: no external preamp included, but it comes with an RCA cable and a spare cartridge (Shure M44-7). I also have a cheap USB phono preamp I can toss in if needed (not audiophile quality).

maria: omg the plant!! how big is it? can i claim the plant only? small studio apt but i have a sunny window.

alex: plant's about 4ft tall in a 10" pot, needs bright indirect light. you can absolutely take the plant only — i'll update the DM list if someone else wants the turntable.

ops-bot: Reminder: please do not leave items blocking the sidewalk. For larger pickups, consider tagging #office-swap for help and coordination.

jamal: i have a hatchback and a dolly. happy to help move the plant to @maria if she wants it. @maria you free Fri 2–4pm?

maria: yes 2:30 works for me. jamal you're a lifesaver :raised_hands:

taylor: small PSA — last month my neighbor's curbside stuff got nabbed overnight. i'd recommend coordinating a quick handoff and not leaving the plant unattended.

alex: solid advice. i'll be there 2–3pm to hand items off in person. jamal if you can bring straps/dolly that'd be awesome. i'll DM the exact address.

jamal: will bring straps + hand truck. also happy to take the cartridge if alex is fine with that.

alex: cartridge's yours if you haul it — first come first served. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Noted. This thread has been logged per #office-swap guidelines.
